proposals.issue_title: Lack of Unified Image Generation Fallback Wrapper
proposals.current_pain_description: Each pipeline handles its own image generation calls. With Hugging Face and Gemini failing, and Pollinations yielding raw/low-quality results, pipelines fail individually or produce unmarketable assets without a structured fallback plan.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a centralized helper script `image_factory.py` that implements a strict fallback sequence: 1) Together AI (Flux-schnell), 2) Cloudflare Workers AI (if quotas remain), 3) Runware (if TOGETHER_API_KEY fails, with strict cost-tracking), 4) Pollinations (as absolute fallback). If all fail, gracefully terminate with an error code instead of generating corrupted/blank files.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Zero wasted GHA runs, automatic quality maximization depending on API availability, and robust error handling.

proposals.current_pain_description: With a hard 20 EUR/month limit, a malfunctioning loop or recursive trigger in GitHub Actions could completely drain the Runware account balance in minutes.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a state-locked daily budget cap inside the GHA workflow. Save daily consumption (image count * cost per image) to a file in the repository (e.g., `budget_state.json`) updated via Git commit at the end of each run. Abort any run if the daily spending exceeds 0.66 EUR (20 EUR / 30 days).
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Guarantees Hugo never exceeds his 20 EUR/month budget due to automated script errors.

proposals.current_pain_description: KDP rejects books during manual review if margins, bleed, page count (must be even), or color profiles are off. Fixing this on an Android phone via Termux is extremely tedious.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a `kdp_preflight_checker.py` script to the end of KDP pipelines. This script uses PyPDF2/pdfplumber to programmatically verify: 1) Page count is even, 2) Dimensions match standard sizes (e.g., 8.5x11 inches) exactly with bleed calculated, 3) Contrast is high enough for coloring pages, 4) No elements extend into the safe margin zone.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents KDP upload rejections which take 24-72 hours to hear back from, speeding up feedback loops.

proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo operates only on an Android phone via Termux. Downloading 100MB+ PDF/ZIP files to inspect them consumes his limited mobile data and phone storage.
proposals.proposed_fix: Configure GHA to generate low-resolution preview grids (contact sheets of 4x4 thumbnails) and compile them into a lightweight WebP image (< 500KB) sent directly to Hugo via a Telegram Bot API message. The high-res files stay safely in GitHub Releases or Actions Artifacts until ready for upload.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves massive mobile data and allows instant, visual quality control directly on Hugo's phone screen in seconds.

proposals.current_pain_description: Assets are generated for one specific pipeline and discarded. For example, a high-quality line-art design for a coloring book is not saved to be sold as a digital SVG cut file or transparent PNG clip art.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create an asset router pipeline (`agent_winner_amplifier`) that takes verified high-quality outputs from `produce_coloring_book` and auto-converts/packages them into: 1) Transparent PNGs for POD, 2) SVG vectors using Potrace, 3) Digital paper packs. It then prepares metadata for Etsy and Cults3D.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies inventory listings by 3x with zero extra generation costs or API calls.

proposals.current_pain_description: If a GHA runner fails due to API limits, git conflicts, or script errors, Hugo has no visibility unless he manually navigates the GitHub UI on his mobile browser.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate a lightweight notification step using curl to a free Telegram/Discord webhook at the end of every workflow. It should send the run status, generation statistics, and direct links to the generated artifacts only if there is a failure, or when a high-value product is successfully packaged.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Ensures immediate awareness of system health without constant manual checking.
